purpose: Trigger behavior spec. CI checks that positive prompts match the skill description more strongly than near-misses.

cases.prompt: check my wallet balances on every chain
cases.assert: Runs the mm readiness gate, then reads balances with the mm CLI and reports them per chain.

cases.prompt: swap 100 USDC for ETH with my MetaMask wallet
cases.assert: Gets a swap quote, shows from/to tokens, amount, chain, slippage, and quoted output, and executes only after the user confirms.

cases.prompt: move my tokens from Base to Arbitrum using cross-chain bridges
cases.assert: Quotes the bridge, confirms source and destination chains and amounts, and executes only after approval.

cases.prompt: this API endpoint returned 402 Payment Required, pay for it
cases.assert: Runs x402_pay.py inspect, shows the terms, and pays with --confirm --approved only after the user approves that option.

cases.prompt: decode this EVM calldata for me
cases.assert: Uses the mm decode command and explains the decoded function and arguments.

cases.prompt: show me open prediction markets I can trade
cases.assert: Lists prediction markets through the mm CLI without placing any order.

cases.prompt: write a Solidity smart contract for an NFT collection
cases.assert: Does not trigger for smart contract authoring, which the mm CLI does not do.

cases.prompt: explain how gas fees work conceptually
cases.assert: Does not trigger for a conceptual explanation that needs no wallet.

cases.prompt: add a connect button to my React app
cases.assert: Does not trigger for building a dapp frontend.
Does not trigger for installing an unrelated package.
